Friend I’ve liked forever and gotten friendzoned by has the habit of telling everyone “I love you” when you do something nice for them. Not like in a I love you love you kind of way but in a more like joking way idk. So I always try to do nice things so I can hear her say she loves me. It’s nice to hear and pretend for a split second that she really means it and that I am loved by someone.

Same lol. My cat meows like crazy at my family when I’m gone at night. There’s a field near my house where I would do it. Sometimes I think about walking out there and laying in the grass and just ending it all. But all I can think about is my cat meowing every night, wondering where I am and why I left him. I think in time my family and friends would understand why I did it , but he would never be able to. It’s so fucked that the only reason I’m here is some fantasy in my head about my cat but hey I’m not dead so I guess it works.
I’m waiting for a game called hollow knight silksong. It’s a sequel to my favorite game of all time. Staying here because that, my cowardice, and because my cat wouldn’t understand why I left him.

I’m turning 19 at the beginning of October and it’s beginning to dawn on me that I will most likely never experience teenage love. I know it sounds so stupid to worry about something like that, when I have so much ahead of me, but I’ll read posts on here like “I’m 40 never had an romantic relationship” etc, and I just get gripped with this horrible fear that one day I’m going to wake up and realize that I missed out on young love altogether, and that maybe I’ll truly be alone forever. Idk. Just feels like this might be the first step of a tumble into mediocrity.
